description: A polyphonic quantizer for any tuning a Scala file can describe, with a grid of 36 buttons choosing which steps of that tuning may be played

params.text: Switches its own step of the loaded tuning on or off; a step switched off is never played, and a button past the end of the tuning does nothing

inputs.text: Switches steps on and off from a cable: every step is switched off, then each channel of the signal here switches on the one step its voltage maps to
The pitches to be quantised, 1V per octave, up to sixteen channels

outputs.text: Each channel of the pitch input moved onto a step of the tuning that is switched on, 1V per octave, by whichever of the three mapping modes is chosen

notes: the module comes up as plain twelve-note equal temperament with every note switched on. Right-click, open Change tuning and load a Scala file for anything else.
the buttons run in reading order, three to a row. The first is the root of the tuning, and the rest follow in the order the Scala file lists them.
a button lit bright red is a step switched on and a dim red one a step switched off. Orange marks a step being quantised to. Buttons past the end of the tuning stay dark.
while a cable is in the cv jack the buttons are overridden and only the steps that cable names are on. Pulling the cable out brings back the selection that was there before it went in.
0V comes out as 0V in all three mapping modes.
the tuning is built out only from -4V to 6V, about 16Hz to 17kHz with 0V at middle C. A pitch outside that is quantised to whichever end it is nearest.
a failed Scala file makes the top button blink red four times, and the tuning that was loaded stays in use.
bypassing the module passes the pitch input straight to the output.
menu: Tuning: — a label naming the tuning in use, which reads 12-EDO until a Scala file is loaded
Change tuning — opens the last ten Scala files loaded by any copy of this module, plus Load scala file for picking a new one
Load scala file — inside Change tuning, opens a file chooser and makes the chosen Scala file the tuning
Disable all notes — switches every step of the tuning off
Enable all notes — switches every step of the tuning on
Mapping mode main: Proximity, Proportional, 12-EDO input — how the pitch input is mapped: to the nearest step that is on, to steps given equal slices of the range, or semitone by semitone
Mapping mode CV: Proximity, Proportional, 12-EDO input — the same three mappings, for the voltages at the cv jack that pick which steps are on
